links.outcome: Readability (ARLC, FKGL, FKRE) and quality (mEQIP, DISCERN, QUEST) of chatbot bladder cancer patient information
links.effect: Readability differed significantly across chatbots (ARLC p=0.002, FKGL p=0.001, FKRE p=0.002). Google Palm was easiest to read and Llama most difficult. Overall quality and readability were moderate.
links.quote: AI chatbots can produce information on BC that is of moderate quality and readability, while there is significant variability among platforms.

screen.reason: Evaluates and benchmarks the quality and readability of responses to bladder cancer queries across 10 commercial LLM chatbots.
